title: How To Submit Tokens To Start Mining OneCoin After A Split
description: Subscribe to the channel and review more videos.

asr.full_text: When you get closer to a split you wanna make sure that immediately after the split happens, you want to start submitting your tokens to OneCoin so they can start mining OneCoins for you. For example, in this token area you're gonna see a number of tokens between one 1000, 5000, 10,000, 30,000 or 60,000, 10000, 30000, or 60000. Immediately after the split, the number will double. The reason why it is important to submit the tokens immediately is that onecoin will re-evaluate a new value placed on onecoin with the difficulty rate which means it will take more tokens to get one coin then it did before the reevaluation so its very important you take immediate action Now, how do you submit them for mining? What we want to do is go here to the exchange on the left hand side over here on the right, you will see little dump truck with the one coin in the back called mining. You want to click on that button. And then what you want to do is come down and you'll see the tokens to submit. Now you'll see how many tokens you have available to start with right here. You want to put that number here in the tokens to have available to start with right here And you want to put that number here in the tokens to submit, and click submit It takes a little while for this to update in the system but you may see this either change from you are not mining to you are mining You'll see your tokens zero out here and if you check your dashboard, you'll also see them disappear from this area. Make sure you do this immediately after any split that you have tokens waiting. And make sure you pass this video on so that your team members know if they don't start mining just before a reevaluation they will pay a higher rate per coin

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes participation in a token-based mining scheme by claiming that submitted tokens will generate OneCoins and that the token amount will double after a split. It gives step-by-step instructions to submit tokens immediately, uses urgency about avoiding a higher per-coin rate, and tells viewers to pass the video to team members. The video actively encourages participation in a mining-for-income mechanism rather than merely discussing or criticizing it.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the video links submitting tokens to mining participation and the generation of OneCoins, presents a mining dashboard, and instructs viewers how to activate that process. The evidence supports the mining-income mechanism itself; it does not rely solely on the presence of a cryptocurrency or a displayed balance.
